resolution_rules.R1_verdict_normalization: Judge A 'merge' and Judge C 'duplicate_of' both mean remove-as-duplicate into an explicit surviving target. Judge B 'mutate' means keep with required reformulation. 'drop' is a quality/prior-art removal vote.
resolution_rules.R2_dedup_union: An idea is removed as duplicate if >=1 dedup judge (A or C) names an explicit merge/duplicate target. Rationale: a duplicate relation is positively evidenced from the two in-corpus idea texts (checkable without external facts), whereas missing a duplicate is easy; and removal is lossless - the relation is recorded as absorbed_duplicates on the surviving anchor. Consolidator spot-checked 12 pairs against the raw idea texts, including 8 single-judge cases, and confirmed each pair shares the same core claim (see report.md).
resolution_rules.R3_target_survival: Merge targets must themselves be accepted. Chains are followed to the final anchor; cycles are a hard error. Where both dedup judges flagged the same idea, their targets were asserted identical (8/8 agreed).
resolution_rules.R4_quality_drop_majority: Removal for prior-art/weakness reasons requires >=2 of 3 judges voting drop, because such drops rest on external prior-art claims that were not citation-verified (evidence policy forbids inventing citations; Judge A marked its own drops advisory). All 4 drop votes in this batch were solo (Judge A) with Judges B and C voting keep, so the 2-1 keep majority retains them, flagged stage2_priorart_check_required.
resolution_rules.R5_mutation_passthrough: Judge B 'mutate' verdicts (all falsifiable=true, permutation_flag=true) are accepted with mutation_required=true carrying Judge B's salvage note; Stage 2 must apply the reformulation before further promotion.
resolution_rules.R6_precedence: Dedup removal (R2) takes precedence over mutate and drop votes on the same idea. No overlap occurred in this batch (asserted).
resolution_rules.R7_no_invented_evidence: The consolidator adds no novelty or prior-art claims of its own and verified no judge note is treated as fact; all carried notes remain advisory. No citations were invented.
